about.description: ZeroLab focuses on motion capture, embodied AI teleoperation, and data acquisition. We provide full-stack solutions, including self-developed, low-cost, high-precision wireless motion capture SiP chips and modules, full-body inertial motion capture systems, teleoperation platforms, and a bipedal robot high-dynamic imitation platform. ZeroLab builds an ecosystem based on mocap and teleoperation technologies, constructing an embodied AI database based on real world data to accelerate the training of embodied AI brains in generalized scenarios.

items.description: Using inertial full-body motion capture devices to collect human motion data for training humanoid robots is a cutting-edge and highly efficient approach. Unlike traditional camera-based motion capture systems, inertial motion capture devices are not affected by ambient lighting or occlusion, making them ideal for data collection in diverse complex environments. By capturing large volumes of high-quality human motion data, it provides rich training samples for the motion control systems of humanoid robots.
items.title: Humanoid Robot Training

items.description: Film and television production is a traditional market for motion capture. Genres such as sci-fi, fantasy, wuxia, and animation rely heavily on VFX, which in turn depend on motion capture technology. With technological advancements, high-precision inertial and hybrid inertial-optical capture systems have emerged, significantly reducing costs while achieving accuracy comparable to optical systems.

items.description: The sports sector can be divided into two markets: professional sports and amateur recreation. In fields such as golf, rowing, fencing, running, and soccer, precise motion capture enables athlete performance evaluation, technique improvement, and comparative analysis against competitors' data.

items.description: Motion capture technology enables VR users to experience true immersion and interactivity. items.description: One major application of motion capture is virtual digital humans. introduction.description: MoCap Tele-OpenArm-Zm is a mobile, full-body motion-capture and teleoperation system for humanoid robots.
